description: Seed list of deliverable tasks per VIOS Practice stage, used by vios-engage:vios-engagement-setup to fill the client's single '<Client> — Deliverables' list (one list, Stage field per task; statuses from setup/clickup.json). Only the stages in scope are seeded. Task names are the deliverable keys the stage skills write at stages.<stage>.deliverables.<key> (each skill names its key per step), so the seed follows the skills, never the other way; the 'Stage N sign-off' task of each stage is moved to approved by the front door's 'Sign off what's waiting' route (vios-engage:vios), not by the stage skill. Since 2026-11-02 there are no lists per stage; the 'statuses' block below is kept for the record of the pre-2026-11-02 layout.

lists.name: Engagement
lists.note: The six keys of status.json > stages.Engagement.deliverables (docs/skill-contract.md); ClickUp task names carry the client: 'Intake <Client>', 'Proposal <Client> vN', 'Setup <Client>', 'Baseline <Client>', 'Harvest <Client>', 'Report <Client> <Month YYYY>'. Intake and Proposal are moved in from 'Department - Setup & SOP' at setup step 2, not re-created; the chase list is the Open facts list; the case recommendation is harvest step 4.
